{{Quote|I should think that you Jedi would have more respect for the difference between knowledge and wisdom.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Episode 2" />}}
'''Dexter "Dex" Jettster''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] with a diverse past hailing from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]]. After leaving his homeworld, he had a colorful life and varied careers, including prospecting, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], running guns, and even a stint as a professional fighter. He owned and ran [[Dex's Donuts]] and later [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. Shortly [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|before]] the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jettster was running the diner in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]]. Due to his wide experience, he was known as a reliable informant. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] often turned to him when they needed some information.

==Biography==
===Many professions===
{{Quote|I ain't seen one of these since I was prospecting on Subterrel, beyond the Outer Rim.|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="Episode 2" />}}
[[File:Subterrel.jpg|left|thumb|Dexter discovers a [[Kamino/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]] in a mine on [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]].]]
Dexter Jettster was born on [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]]. At one point in his life, he was a professional fighter.<ref name="DB" /> He left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and spent many years roaming the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] from the Deep Core to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] as he bounced between jobs. One of his first jobs was working as a street tout for a restaurant on the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor shipyards]]. Directing gullible tourists to the restaurant he was fronting was his first exposure to the food service industry. At one point Dex continued his career as a fighter on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] where he wrestled [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrips]] for a living. During his time in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]] Dex served chow to the soldiers of a militia camp. He traded [[furbog]]s along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] in exchange for an unusual array of items.<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> Eventually became a prospector for a mine on the planet of [[Subterrel/Legends|Subterrel]], where he saw a [[Kamino/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|saberdart]] used by [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massans]].<ref name="vd">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> By [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]<ref name="llow">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref> he set up a bar on the remote Outer Rim mining world of [[Ord Sigatt]], where he used the bar as a cover for running guns.<ref name="DB" /> While running the bar, Dex met [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], after dropping bottles in an alley,<ref name="llow" /> and took a liking to him.<ref name="DB" /> Dex continued to running guns in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] where he supplied [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] settlers with arms in exchange for their [[Ardees/Legends|Jawa juice]] recipe. <ref name="Dex" />

Shortly thereafter, Dex opened a weapon shop on the [[Outland Transit Station]] and used the proceeds and the last of his savings to fund his trip to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dex" /> Dex started fresh on the streets of Coruscant by opening a donut stand named [[Dex's Donuts]]. As the years passed, it seemed impossible for Dex to upgrade to a real restaurant with his modest income. One day, an inattentive driver landed their [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] on top of Dex's Donuts, destroying the stand and leaving Dex with a cracked cranial crest and three broken arms. After spending a week in a med center, Dex used the settlement payment from the taxi company to buy and renovate<ref name="Dex" /> a [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] in [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]]<ref name="DB" /> from [[Didi Oddo]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref> For many years it had been his dream to open a restaurant in the best part of the city-planet. Dex incorporated the many recipes he collected and the cooking he sampled on countless worlds during his years roaming the galaxy into the food he served at Dex's Diner.<ref name="Dex" /> 

Jettster encountered Obi-Wan Kenobi again when the unidentifiable [[Vercupti of sgazza boleruueé/Legends|vercupti of sgazza boleruueé]] served at the [[Jedi Temple Main House|Jedi Temple main house]] drove the young Jedi to try the diner.<ref name="Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> To Jettster's delight, Kenobi visited the café again in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], looking for information on his new enemy, [[Granta Omega]]. Although Jettster knew nothing about Omega, he offered Kenobi his hospitality and beverages, as well as a research on this person. Kenobi took the opportunity to introduce his new Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Jettster.<ref name="JQ2">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref>

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|These Kaminoans keep to themselves. They're cloners. Damn good ones too.''"<br />"''Cloners. Are they friendly?''"<br />"''Depends.''"<br />"''Depends on what, Dex?''"<br />"''On how good your manners are, and how big your&hellip; pocketbook is.|Dexter Jettster educates Obi-Wan Kenobi on the pre-Clone Wars Kaminoans|<ref name="Episode 2" />}}
[[File:Dex_in_the_kitchen.png|thumb|right|230px|Dex in the kitchen of his diner]]
Prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dex identified a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Kamino saberdart]], similar of those used by the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massans]], as a favor for Kenobi. This led the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to discover that [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] had been deleted from the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and after that went to the planet itself, where he found out about the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] had ordered from the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]]. The Clone Wars began soon afterwards.<ref name="Episode 2" /> Despite the rapidly spreading galactic conflict, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] risked traveling for ingredients for his diner to places such as [[Dractu]] for [[Dractuvian cave slug|cave slugs]] as a gift for Kenobi.<ref name="Appetite for Adventure">{{CWACite|9|Appetite for Adventure}}</ref>

Two months into the Clone Wars, Dexter heard crucial information from a female that owed him a [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was going to [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|attack]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. Worried, he gave this information to Obi-Wan, resulting in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] leaving to stop Grievous.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>

Near the war's end, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] sought him out for information on an [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] assassin, [[Sajé Tasha]], and asked the Besalisk to put out the word that his [[Marriage/Legends|fiancée]], [[Khaleen Hentz/Legends|Khaleen Hentz]], wanted to hire her for a job. This led to Quinlan Vos mistakenly identifying [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="RT">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

===Joining the Erased===
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Dex went into hiding to avoid persecution by the Empire and his diner was destroyed. He joined a group called the [[Erased]], which consisted of people who had erased all records of their existence. At some point, he talked to a Jedi named [[Fy-Tor-Ana]], who told him to find "Solace" if he needed help.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Underworld" />

During the early [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], Dex was sought out by former Jedi [[Ferus Olin]], as he was looking for Jedi who survived the Purge. Dex informed Ferus of Solace, who went to find them, along with the rest of the Erased, but Dex stayed behind to help any possible new members.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Underworld" /> Later, after an attack on Solace's base, Ferus was captured. The Erased came back to Dex for his help in the rescue of Ferus. He outfitted them with an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]] and a [[Jedi starfighter]] to help them get to [[Dontamo]], the planet on which Ferus was being held.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

He was shot during an attack on his hideout, but survived and recovered. He later said goodbye to [[Keets Freely]] and [[Curran Caladian]] when they decided to go down to the deeper levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for safety.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dexter Jettster's voice was performed by [[Ronald Falk]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].

Early drafts had him being the husband of [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]], his waitress.<ref name="DB Hermoione">{{DB|character|hermionebagwa|Bagwa, Hermione}}</ref>

He was one of a few characters in the films to swear, the others being [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'' Episode IV: ''A New Hope'']], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'' Episode V: ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Specifically, Jettster uses the word "damn" when describing the Kaminoans' skills in cloning.

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'', Dexter Jettster appears as the sole bartender of his diner, this being the level hub of the game. He is an unplayable character.

In ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', Dexter Jettster is a playable character with no abilities and no weapons. This lack of armament makes him little more than a novelty.

Jettster was named after [[George Lucas]]' son [[Jett Lucas]].<ref name="Twitter Q&A">{{Twitter|starwars|status/21156643246|[[StarWars.com]]|quote=Lucas explains "Ewok" name from "Miwok." "Dexter Jettster" is from his son. Darth Vader is "dark father or dark water."|archivedate=20190904233452}}</ref>
